## What Would Need to Be Tested (Recommendations)

### Unit Tests (High Priority)
- `safe_parse_scientific()` — edge cases: empty string, `'*D'` suffixes, `'E'` without exponent
- `decode_to_dict()` — channel count mismatch, NaN propagation
- `ensure_xml_file()` — DOY rollover at midnight
- `Datalog.list_file()` — empty folder, no XML, corrupt XML, `ntries` counter

### Integration Tests
- Full XML write → read cycle (`34970A_5.py` write → `TestcodeLogging34970A_v2.py` parse)
- `parse_files()` with actual XML fixture files
- Day boundary rollover in logger

### Instrument Simulation
- `pyvisa` — would need NI-VISA mock or `pyvisa-sim` for offline testing
- GPIB responses can be simulated with `pyvisa-sim` yaml config
